checks.setup: Front oblique and side sheets inspected; complete body and apparatus visible.
checks.hands: Opposite arm reaches overhead as one leg extends; the other arm stays vertical.
checks.feet: One leg extends from tabletop, returns, then the other leg extends with the trunk stationary.
checks.movement: From supine tabletop, extend one leg and the opposite arm, return, then alternate without lifting or twisting the trunk.

limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
